quests.instruction: Which round part spins to help a vehicle roll along the ground?
quests.hint: Think about the round part at each corner of a car that spins as it drives.
quests.explanation: A wheel is a round part that spins to help a vehicle move. Most vehicles roll along on several wheels!
quests.funFact: The wheel is considered one of the most important inventions in all of human history!

quests.instruction: Which part of a vehicle burns fuel to create the power that makes it move?
quests.hint: Think about the powerful part hidden under the hood that gives a car the energy to move.
quests.explanation: An engine is the part that creates power to move a vehicle. Engines burn fuel to make a vehicle go!
quests.funFact: An engine has many small parts working together perfectly to create enough power to move a heavy car!

quests.instruction: Which flat part sticks out from each side of an airplane to help it fly?
quests.hint: Think about the long, flat part on each side of an airplane that helps lift it into the sky.
quests.explanation: A wing is a flat part that helps an airplane fly. Air flowing over the wings lifts an airplane up!
quests.funFact: A bird's wing and an airplane's wing both use the very same shape to help create lift!

quests.instruction: Which spinning set of blades pushes an airplane or boat forward through air or water?
quests.hint: Think about the fast-spinning blades on the front of a small airplane, pulling it through the sky.
quests.explanation: A propeller is a spinning set of blades that pushes a vehicle forward. Propellers move both airplanes and boats!
quests.funFact: A propeller spins so fast that its blades can look almost like a blur!

quests.instruction: Which heavy hooked object drops into the water to keep a boat from drifting away?
quests.hint: Think about the heavy metal hook a sailor drops into the water to keep the boat in one place.
quests.explanation: An anchor is a heavy hooked object that keeps a boat in place. Sailors drop an anchor before they rest!
quests.funFact: An anchor's curved shape helps it dig firmly into the sand or mud under the water!

quests.instruction: Which large piece of cloth catches the wind to push a boat forward?
quests.hint: Think about the tall triangle of cloth on a boat that fills up with wind and pushes it along.
quests.explanation: A sail is a large cloth that catches wind to push a boat. Sailors adjust the sail to catch the best wind!
quests.funFact: A sail's curved shape helps it catch wind almost the same way an airplane wing catches air!

quests.instruction: Which flat part underwater at the back of a boat turns to steer it left or right?
quests.hint: Think about the flat piece hidden underwater at the back of a boat that turns to change its direction.
quests.explanation: A rudder is a flat part that steers a boat. Turning the rudder helps a boat turn left or right!
quests.funFact: Airplanes have a rudder too, hidden inside their tail, to help them turn while flying!

quests.instruction: Which tall pole rises up from a sailboat to hold its sail in place?
quests.hint: Think about the tall, straight pole standing up in the middle of a sailboat, holding the sail high.
quests.explanation: A mast is a tall pole that holds a sailboat's sail. The sail is attached to the mast to catch the wind!
quests.funFact: A tall ship can have several masts, each one holding up its very own set of sails!

quests.instruction: Which bright light on the front of a vehicle helps a driver see in the dark?
quests.hint: Think about the bright lights on the front of a car that switch on to light up a dark road at night.
quests.explanation: A headlight is a bright light on the front of a vehicle. Headlights help drivers see the road at night!
quests.funFact: Headlights also help other drivers see your car clearly, even on a dark, rainy night!

quests.instruction: Which red light on the back of a vehicle warns drivers behind it?
quests.hint: Think about the red lights on the back of a car that glow to warn the car driving behind it.
quests.explanation: A taillight is a red light on the back of a vehicle. Taillights warn drivers behind when a car slows down!
quests.funFact: Taillights glow extra bright the moment a driver presses down on the brakes!

quests.instruction: Which part of a car makes a loud honking sound to warn other drivers?
quests.hint: Think about the button in the middle of the steering wheel that makes a loud honking sound.
quests.explanation: A horn is a part that makes a loud honking sound. Drivers press the horn to warn others of danger!
quests.funFact: A car horn should only be used to warn others, never just to make noise for fun!

quests.instruction: Which loud, wailing sound warns everyone that an emergency vehicle is rushing past?
quests.hint: Think about the loud, wailing sound an ambulance makes as it rushes quickly through busy traffic.
quests.explanation: A siren is a loud, wailing sound on emergency vehicles. Sirens warn everyone to make way quickly!
quests.funFact: A siren's changing pitch helps drivers notice it and figure out which direction it is coming from!

quests.instruction: Which round part does a driver turn with their hands to steer a car left or right?
quests.hint: Think about the round wheel a driver holds and turns to guide the car around a corner.
quests.explanation: A steering wheel is a round part for steering a car. Drivers turn the steering wheel to change direction!
quests.funFact: Turning a steering wheel gently and smoothly helps keep a car's ride nice and steady!

quests.instruction: Which part does a cyclist grip with both hands to steer a bicycle?
quests.hint: Think about the bar at the front of a bicycle that a rider holds with both hands to steer.
quests.explanation: A handlebar is a part a cyclist grips to steer. Riders turn the handlebar to guide their bicycle!
quests.funFact: A handlebar often has a bell or brakes attached, right where a rider's thumbs can easily reach!

quests.instruction: Which flat part does your foot push down on to power a bicycle forward?
quests.hint: Think about the flat part under your foot that you push around and around to make a bicycle move.
quests.explanation: A pedal is a part your foot pushes to power a bicycle. Pushing the pedals makes the wheels turn!
quests.funFact: Pushing bicycle pedals in smooth, steady circles helps you ride farther without getting tired!

quests.instruction: Which part of a vehicle helps it slow down or stop safely?
quests.hint: Think about the part a driver presses with their foot whenever they need the car to slow down.
quests.explanation: A brake is a part that helps a vehicle slow down. Pressing the brake keeps everyone safe while stopping!
quests.funFact: A car's brakes use rubbing force to turn its moving energy into heat, which slows it down!

quests.instruction: Which shiny part lets a driver see the traffic behind their car without turning around?
quests.hint: Think about the shiny glass part a driver glances at to see the cars behind without turning their head.
quests.explanation: A mirror is a shiny part that shows what is behind a vehicle. Drivers check mirrors before changing lanes!
quests.funFact: Cars have several mirrors so a driver can check almost every direction around them!

quests.instruction: Which part at the very front and back of a car helps absorb a gentle bump?
quests.hint: Think about the sturdy part at the front and back of a car that protects it from small bumps.
quests.explanation: A bumper is a part at the front and back of a car. Bumpers help absorb the shock of a small bump!
quests.funFact: Bumpers are specially designed to protect the rest of a car from minor dents and scratches!

quests.instruction: Which storage space at the back of a car holds luggage and groceries?
quests.hint: Think about the storage space at the very back of a car where you load bags before a trip.
quests.explanation: A trunk is a storage space at the back of a car. We load bags and groceries into the trunk!
quests.funFact: A trunk's lid lifts up so you can easily load and unload heavy or bulky items!

quests.instruction: Which cover on the front of a car lifts up to show the engine underneath?
quests.hint: Think about the flat cover on the front of a car that a mechanic lifts up to check the engine.
quests.explanation: A hood is a cover on the front of a car. Lifting the hood shows the engine hidden underneath!
quests.funFact: A mechanic lifts the hood whenever the engine needs to be checked or repaired!

quests.instruction: Which large piece of glass at the front of a car lets the driver see the road ahead?
quests.hint: Think about the big piece of glass right in front of the driver's seat, letting them see the road.
quests.explanation: A windshield is a large piece of glass at the front of a car. Windshields let a driver see the road clearly!
quests.funFact: A windshield is made from special glass that stays together even if it gets cracked!

quests.instruction: Which metal plate on a vehicle displays letters and numbers to identify it?
quests.hint: Think about the metal plate on the front and back of a car showing its own special letters and numbers.
quests.explanation: A license plate is a metal plate with letters and numbers. Every vehicle has its own unique license plate!
quests.funFact: Police officers can use a license plate's letters and numbers to help identify a specific vehicle!

quests.instruction: Which strap crosses over your body to keep you safely in your seat?
quests.hint: Think about the strap you pull across your chest and click into place before a car starts moving.
quests.explanation: A seatbelt is a strap that keeps you safely in your seat. Wearing a seatbelt keeps every rider safer!
quests.funFact: Buckling a seatbelt takes only a few seconds but can help keep a rider much safer!

quests.instruction: Which small front area of an airplane is where the pilot sits and flies the plane?
quests.hint: Think about the small space at the very front of an airplane, filled with buttons and controls for the pilot.
quests.explanation: A cockpit is the front area where a pilot sits. Pilots use the controls inside a cockpit to fly the plane!
quests.funFact: A cockpit is filled with dials, screens, and switches that help a pilot fly safely!

quests.instruction: Which main area of an airplane or boat is where passengers sit during the trip?
quests.hint: Think about the roomy area where passengers sit in their seats during a long flight.
quests.explanation: A cabin is the main area where passengers sit. Passengers relax inside the cabin during a trip!
quests.funFact: An airplane cabin is pressurized so passengers can breathe comfortably, even high in the sky!

quests.instruction: Which strong outer shell of a boat or ship keeps water from getting inside?
quests.hint: Think about the strong, curved outer shell of a ship that keeps the water outside where it belongs.
quests.explanation: A hull is the strong outer shell of a boat. The hull keeps water safely outside a ship!
quests.funFact: A ship's hull must be built extremely strong to handle powerful ocean waves!

quests.instruction: Which flat, open floor on top of a ship is where passengers can walk and enjoy the view?
quests.hint: Think about the flat, open floor at the top of a ship where passengers stroll and enjoy the sea breeze.
quests.explanation: A deck is a flat, open floor on a ship. Passengers walk and relax on a ship's deck!
quests.funFact: A big cruise ship can have many different decks stacked on top of each other!

quests.instruction: Which toothed wheel inside a vehicle helps control its speed and power?
quests.hint: Think about the toothed wheel a cyclist or driver switches to help pedal or drive more easily.
quests.explanation: A gear is a toothed wheel that controls speed and power. Switching gears helps a vehicle move more easily!
quests.funFact: Bicycles often have many gears to help riders pedal easily up hills or speed along flat roads!

quests.instruction: Which rod connects two wheels together and lets them spin?
quests.hint: Think about the long rod running underneath a car, connecting one wheel to the wheel on the other side.
quests.explanation: An axle is a rod that connects two wheels. Wheels spin around an axle as a vehicle moves!
quests.funFact: A single car usually has two axles, one connecting the front wheels and one connecting the back wheels!

quests.instruction: Which pipe at the back of a car lets used engine gases safely escape?
quests.hint: Think about the pipe underneath the back of a car where a little puff of smoke comes out.
quests.explanation: An exhaust pipe is a pipe that lets used gases escape. Exhaust pipes are found at the back of a vehicle!
quests.funFact: An exhaust pipe helps carry gases safely away from the engine and out of the car!
